Claude Code with these 5 MCPs is unrecognizable.  Here’s the stack 👇 1️⃣ Perplexity MCP: gives Claude live internet access. No more “based on my training data.” 2️⃣ Playwright MCP: Claude drives a real browser. It clicks around, fills out forms, and tests your app like a QA engineer. 3️⃣ Firecrawl MCP: crawls entire sites and dumps the content straight into your conversation. 4️⃣ Glif MCP: hooks Claude up to hundreds of image and video models, and it even writes the prompts for you. 5️⃣ Chrome MCP: Claude reads whatever’s open in your tabs. Live page state, live context.  What makes this stack insane: ✅ Real-time web data instead of stale training data ✅ A browser Claude can actually control ✅ Whole websites pulled into context in one command ✅ Images and videos generated without leaving your terminal ✅ Claude sees exactly what you see in Chrome  Why this matters: this is how Claude Code stops being a chatbot and starts being a teammate.
